pipeline_note: PIPELINE BUG CONFIRMED: in the gemma3-27b bf16 run, add_held_out_tag was called with only 100 rows (the 100 evaluation passages). The serve_cache has 10000 rows. add_held_out_tag internally sliced cache[:100], but the 100 passage IDs are SCATTERED (not sequential 0..99; pids ranged 7..1981), so the lstsq target (cache[0..99] = passages 0..99) was completely misaligned with h_acts (which corresponds to passages 853,1500,20,...). This makes enc_M fit random noise. Positive control (12b, full 10k) reproduces cos_ours ≈ 0.61 as expected. gemma3-27b must be re-run with its FULL 10k pool shard.
